decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent communication service that remained prominently marketed across 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm's announced cloud communications direction and a large German provider with visible prior investment is unlikely to withdraw it quickly.

The product is close to the established secure messaging offer and publicly launched on its own page, so despite being newer the firm's sunk development effort and strategic commitment make continuation more likely than exit.

Because it extends the firm's existing enterprise communication workflow portfolio and has already been visibly commercialized, management would tend to interpret any early weakness as temporary and keep it on the market.
